title: The new app and installer icons

steps.path: The Start menu, desktop shortcut, taskbar, Dock and app list, once YouCoded is installed
steps.headline: Replace the app's icon with the robot tile from the youcoded.ai header?

labels.today: Today (left) and new (right), big and at real sizes

steps.changed: The dark terminal square with "YC" becomes the header's lavender tile with the solid purple robot, in every place the app's icon appears, including the taskbar while it runs.
steps.notice: YouCoded looks like its website. On a Mac the tile sits inside a little empty margin, so it lines up with other apps in the Dock.
steps.risk: The icon no longer changes colour with your theme; that comes back later, from the roadmap.

steps.path: The downloaded installer, in Downloads and in search results (the opened Mac disk too)
steps.headline: Which installer icon should the download use?
steps.notice: Each is shown big and at the three sizes Windows really uses, on a light and a dark background.
steps.risk: All three keep the lavender tile and the purple robot, so the installer still reads as YouCoded.

variants.label: Arrow badge
variants.summary: The app icon with a purple arrow badge in the corner, like a notification dot. Closest to the app icon.
variants.risk: At the smallest size the badge shrinks to a dot, so it looks almost like the app itself.

variants.label: Arrow into tray
variants.summary: A small robot above a download arrow and tray. Reads as a download at any size.
variants.risk: At the smallest size the robot is too small to make out.

variants.label: Arrow strip
variants.summary: The robot, with a purple band along the bottom carrying a white arrow. A middle ground between the other two.
variants.risk: At the smallest size the arrow is hard to see.
